observation_domain.schedule: deterministic alternating rows with each case exactly once under each condition

resolver.explicit_invocation: an exact qualified invocation selects the declared slot without materializing a reference bundle
resolver.uncertain: any local_need or reference_need uncertain yields uncertain_abstain with no selected slots or reference bundle
resolver.cap: more than two local_need yes rows yields cap_abstain with no selected slots or reference bundle
resolver.selection: otherwise select local_need yes slots in canonical order
resolver.references: for capsule-fold selections only, emit core or focused reference_need rows in canonical order; explicit invocation and none emit no row

formulas.capsule_local_need_accuracy: exact ordered local_need matches / 160 required capsule rows per condition
formulas.capsule_reference_need_accuracy: exact ordered reference_need matches / 160 required capsule rows per condition
formulas.selected_precision: sum |predicted selected intersect expected selected| / sum |predicted selected|
formulas.selected_recall: sum |predicted selected intersect expected selected| / 36 expected selected slots
formulas.exact_selected_set: exact predicted selected set / 40 required presentations
formulas.abstention_specificity: expected-empty presentations predicted empty / 12 expected-empty presentations
formulas.broad_over_selection: presentations with predicted cardinality greater than expected cardinality / 40
formulas.one_decision_stacking: count expected-single presentations predicting more than one selected slot
formulas.exactly_two_exact_set: exact predicted selected set / 8 profile-two presentations
formulas.cap_abstention: cap profile presentations resolved cap_abstain with empty selection / 4
formulas.explicit_invocation: explicit profile presentations with selected status, exactly the declared slot, and the authority-required empty reference bundle / 4
formulas.must_not_select: sum predicted slots outside each expected selected set
formulas.anchor_grounding: correctly selected slots whose capsule passed exact canonical anchor validation / 36 expected selected slots; explicit invocation remains grounded although its reference bundle is empty
formulas.reference_bundle_correctness: exact predicted reference bundle / 40 required presentations; explicit invocation requires an empty bundle
formulas.payload_cap_violations: count predicted reference bundles longer than two plus malformed sentinels
formulas.implicit_effect_claim_tool_events: sum six forbidden event booleans plus malformed sentinels
formulas.semantic_schema_order: strictly parsed capsule rows with exact capsule and output object key order / 320
formulas.resolver_parity: reported resolution exactly equals evaluator pure resolver output / 80
formulas.unique_capsule_contexts_320: distinct nonempty context identifiers across valid schedule cells
formulas.binding_schedule_packet_parity: capsules matching authority, schedule, task, and deterministic packet digests / 320
formulas.invocation_count_320: count terminal parsed capsules whose invocation_count is exactly integer 1; 0/2 redistribution cannot compensate
